name: Supernova
subtitle: Sideline inbound play
goal: Start bunched up, then explode apart so somebody gets open fast.
options: Pass to whoever gets open first. Come toward the ball: no long, risky passes.

steps.note: 3 inbounds. 1, 2, 4 and 5 bunch up in a tight cluster on the far side of the court.
On "break", everyone explodes out of the cluster in a different direction and works hard to get open. There are no set routes, but come toward the ball.
3 passes to whoever is open first.
